english.note: Use 請 as the everyday all-purpose verb for taking someone on as an employee.

exampleSentences.english: The company will employ a new accountant, who will start work next month.
exampleSentences.traditional: 間公司請咗個新會計，佢下個月返工。
exampleSentences.jyutping: gaan1 gung1 si1 ceng2 zo2 go3 san1 wui6 gai3 keoi5 haa6 go3 jyut6 faan1 gung1

english.note: Use this for engaging or hiring a person to work, rather than for engaging a space or machine.

exampleSentences.english: We’ll engage a new manager for the shop.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我哋會請個新店長返嚟。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 wui5 ceng2 go3 san1 dim3 zoeng2 faan1 lei4
